description: New accelerator cohort companies (YC, a16z Speedrun, South Park Commons, Founders Inc, Z Fellows...) as we detect them, including stealth teams: name, program, batch, sector, one-liner, website and founders. The response carries programs (counts per accelerator) to see what else is there. Not on every plan: a 403 lanes_not_enabled means the plan does not include it. Empty answers are free.

program.description: Accelerator key, e.g. "yc", "speedrun", "spc", "finc", "zfellows" (see programs in any response)

q.description: Search name, handle, one-liner, sector, founder names

since.description: Window: "30d" (default), "7d" or an ISO date. Max 90 days

stealth.description: true = only stealth teams, false = only named companies
